About_&_Key_Points:
About
The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of bead wire, a high-carbon steel wire utilized in the production of tires. Additionally, the Company produces drawn steel wire, commonly referred to as black wire, which finds applications in various industries such as automobile, construction, and engineering.

Key Points
Product Offerings
[1]
a) Tyre Bead Wire:
The company manufactures high-performance tyre bead wire using high-carbon steel. The wire undergoes precision drawing followed by a specialised bronze coating process. It offers a range of customised tensile grades tailored to specific customer requirements and also produces bead wire using recycled steel.
